name: MOS Plastics Inc
old_description: Your solution partner for innovative product development and manufacturer of Medical, Diagnostic, and Pharmaceutical products.  Currier MOS Plastics is ISO 13485 certified and FDA registered regional contract manufacturer offering facilities in Central NY and Southern California.
about:
Currier MOS Plastics operates from San Jose, California, with additional facilities in Central New York and Southern California. The company traces its roots to 1982, when Currier Plastics began pursuing a vision of raising service and quality standards in the molding industry. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public sources.

The company provides turnkey injection molding and blow molding services for Class II and Class III medical devices, running horizontal and vertical injection molding machines inside ISO Class 7 and ISO Class 8 cleanrooms. Capabilities extend to insert molding, two-shot molding, over-molding, and a range of secondary operations including ultrasonic welding, pad and plate printing, cleanroom assembly, kitting, and component preparation. The firm emphasizes end-to-end support from design-for-manufacturing engineering through full-dimensional layout inspection and statistical process control.

Currier MOS Plastics serves medical device, pharmaceutical, drug delivery, diagnostics, life science, and consumer health markets, along with personal care, packaging, consumer products, telecommunications, electronics, and food and beverage sectors. Named customers include Abbott, Agilent, Allergan, and Cepheid, for whom the company produces fluidic components, diagnostic test kits, surgical instruments, implants, syringes, catheters, and electronic device housings.

The company cites its V² philosophy — value multiplied by velocity — as a guiding principle, supported by a continuous improvement program organized into six pillar teams. A sustainability initiative called the 6 Green Program Directions governs material sourcing and waste reduction across its environmentally focused injection and blow molding operations.
